delta.comment: Created by operator-directed contract replanning (2026-08-19) to carry the P-021 C2/C3 semantic regression suite. Rationale: all three prior fix-cycle defects lived on carriers where the clause was PRESENT and byte-identical to its dogfood, so byte-identity and clause-presence tests would both have passed while the contract was self-contradictory. Each prior defect plus the dangling-reconciliation obligation maps to a named failing test, and a NO-PR/NO-THREAD-ASSUMPTION guard targets the shared root cause directly. Depends on 134.011-T (single edge; 011 already transitively orders after all content tasks and establishes the render-helper pattern). Separate test file, so no contention with 011.

Readiness fix cycle 1 (review of 1dad725a): added CARRIER-SET RESOLUTION rule (carrier sets now resolve from the authoritative matrix in 134.011-T; this task must not restate it), C3-SYMMETRIC-GUARD test (H12 scope-contraction guard on both workflow-policies and circuit-breaker, a carrier the matrix previously omitted entirely), and C5-EXCEPTION test providing the policy-to-role-boundary contract coverage that makes the manifest-derived post-merge cleanup exception non-regressable, including a negative guard against an unqualified "or remove" prohibition.

Readiness fix cycle 2 (review of b449dcbf, P1.3/P1.4): all assertions now resolve their carrier subset by behaviour ID (B1-B15) from 134.011-T instead of hardcoding lists. C3-SYMMETRIC-GUARD expanded from two surfaces to the full B9 subset including _ship.agent.md.tmpl and fix-ci/SKILL.md.tmpl as required by 134.004-T and 134.007-T. Added SUBSET-FIDELITY guard, THREAD-PRESENT-ORDERING (B7), C5-BOUNDARY (B11), C1-GATE (B1) and C4-NON-BYPASS (B10). Subsets are justified per behaviour rather than defaulted to the clause row: B4 excludes circuit-breaker (H7 names 004/006/007 as payload carriers), B7 excludes fix-ci and circuit-breaker (no thread to reply on), B8 excludes github-pr-automation and pr-lifecycle (every finding there has a thread), B12 excludes circuit-breaker and the two carve-out surfaces. Negative guards deliberately still run across full clause rows. Size raised M -> L with a pre-declared split line.

Readiness fix cycle 3 (review of 904c46b9, P1): THREAD-PRESENT-ORDERING (B7) now includes fix-ci as a required member; only circuit-breaker remains excluded, since it performs no thread operation. THREADLESS-DISCHARGE (B8) scoped to fix-ci's CI-finding path rather than the whole surface. CAPTURE-FIRST exclusion note corrected to name circuit-breaker only. Added FIX-CI-DUAL-PATH test with a negative guard that must fail against the historical wording "a review thread never surfaces inside a fix-ci run", and FIX-CI-ENTRY-REUSE test asserting no duplicate deferred entry when a captured finding later surfaces on a thread in the same run.

Stage correction operation (checkpoint-20260819-165602, 2026-08-19): bound the two previously unnumbered semantic assertions to behaviour IDs -- FIX-CI-DUAL-PATH is now B16 and FIX-CI-ENTRY-REUSE is now B17 -- so both resolve their carrier subsets from 134.011-T's single-source mapping like every other assertion, and both compute their DERIVED subsets (B7 INTERSECT B8; B6 UNION {007-fix-ci}) from the parents rather than materializing a list. CARRIER-SET RESOLUTION range widened to B1-B17. Three guards now govern the full range: SUBSET-FIDELITY extended to B1-B17 and required to assert the clause-row exemption list is EXACTLY {B6, B17} so no future behaviour can quietly opt out; new RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard asserting the range is exactly B1-B17, every ID is exercised, and NO assertion exists without an ID (the guard that would have caught this defect); new DERIVED-SUBSET guard recomputing each derivation from its parents so a derived subset cannot drift when a parent changes. B17's assertion on 008 takes its Stage-side form: reconciliation attaches late identifiers to the existing entry rather than creating a duplicate.

Follow-on finding from the new RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard (same operation): applying the guard to its own task exposed SEVEN further unnumbered semantic criteria beyond B16/B17 -- C5-EXCEPTION, CONDITIONAL-C3, THREE-RECORD-CITATION, FUSED-REF, SINGLE-WRITE, NO-PR/NO-THREAD-ASSUMPTION, RECONCILIATION-CONSUMER. All mapped onto existing behaviours (B11, B16, B8, B5, B6, B3, B14) and were bound rather than weakening the guard. Two refinements followed: (1) UNIVERSAL scope label for negative guards that run across ALL carriers by design (B5 FUSED-REF, B3 NO-PR/NO-THREAD-ASSUMPTION), so SUBSET-FIDELITY cannot misread their breadth as a subset violation; (2) the guard's first draft wrongly demanded this single file name all seventeen IDs -- B2/B13/B15 are correctly discharged by 134.011-T's literal-clause, precedence and policy-registry tests, so the check now spans BOTH contract-test files via disjoint OWNED_BEHAVIOURS and DISCHARGED_ELSEWHERE constants whose union must equal B1-B17. Verified programmatically: disjoint, union complete, none claimed twice, none orphaned; only the four structural criteria (file existence, canonical gate, docstring convention, marker stability) remain legitimately unnumbered.

B16/B17 correction review cycle 1 (HEAD 77d1a7e0): B16 test rewritten to assert each carrier's OWN selector instead of forcing one across the subset -- 001[A] and 004 asserted on ACTUAL THREAD AVAILABILITY with a negative guard that neither surface conditions the disposition on finding kind (must fail against the historical wording 'selects between them by FINDING KIND' applied to 001 or 004), and 007-fix-ci asserted on its PATH split presented as an implementation of thread availability rather than a competing rule. The threadless-by-nature negative guard is retained. RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard strengthened: discharge is now a COVERAGE claim, not a name-match -- an ID counts as discharged only when its owning test asserts the behaviour's full mapped semantics across its complete declared carrier subset, cross-checked against 134.011-T, with the three known shortfalls (B2 on 005 alone / fewer than four not-sufficient phrases / missing worked cases; B13 on 008 alone; B15 by section-presence without telemetry-AND-halt) named as inputs the guard must reject. Disjointness and union-equals-B1-B17 preserved. Self-audit re-run: B16={001,004,007-fc} subset of C3; B17={004,007-fc,008} with 008 the sole exempt member; allocation disjoint and complete; all three discharged behaviours now cover their full subsets.

Correction cycle 2 (HEAD 663205a6): RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard's known-shortfall list updated for the C1 phrase-count correction -- the B2 shortfall it must reject is now 'fewer than all five not-sufficient phrases' with the five enumerated ('same file','same function','same PR','same subsystem','related'), replacing the incorrect four-phrase threshold. No change to this suite's B9 test, which already required the complete two-part symmetric guard; the correction this cycle was to the CARRIER TASK contracts (134.004-T, 134.005-T, 134.007-T), which authored only part of the guard and therefore could not satisfy the test as written. That inversion -- correct test, under-specified carrier -- is the first of its kind in this feature and is recorded as MATRIX CORRECTION 7 in 134.011-T.

Authority audit (correction cycle 3 of 3). Three corrections: (1) the marker-provenance criterion named three authoring tasks while this suite asserts text authored across eight -- now enumerates all eight with their behaviours, plus the rule that a marker resolves from the task that AUTHORS the text and never from a restating surface; (2) the SINGLE-WRITE negative guard now names the historical defective wording it must fail against (the original thread-present "capture first and only afterward record the PR and review-thread IDs in the captured stash entry" flow); (3) the NO-PR/NO-THREAD guard now names the original "(PR number, review-thread ID when applicable, ...)" enumeration that qualified only the thread ID and so stated the PR unconditionally. The C5-BOUNDARY criterion now points at 134.002-T as the owner of the forbidden verb list, which includes discretionary ARCHIVAL. B3/B7/B11/B12 subsets verified to match the authoritative map exactly; no subset changes needed.

Owner-contract reconciliation (checkpoint-20260819-183625): four assertion-scope corrections. (1) FUSED-REF guard split into a genuinely universal NEGATIVE (no fused PR/thread token on any surface) and a B5-subset-scoped POSITIVE (independent per-field applicability qualifier and explicit N/A) -- the old universal form demanded per-field N/A text on 006 and 007-pr-lifecycle, the two surfaces B5 deliberately excludes because both identifiers always exist there. (2) SINGLE-WRITE/B6 now covers BOTH mapped carriers: Ship writes once and cannot back-fill (004), and Stage consumes the residual-risk records to reconcile late identifiers under its own authority with no Ship write (008). Asserting only the Ship half would pass on a policy that permanently strands every N/A. (3) RECONCILIATION-CONSUMER/B14 now asserts all six owner-defined obligations from 134.008-T (trigger, retrieval by deferred-entry join key, Stage authority, anti-duplication, non-blocking, idempotence); the Stage-authority obligation is flagged as what discharges 008's cross-clause C5 carriage. (4) B17 reuse extended to prior-run captures. Added C5-REFERENCE-ROLE test for new behaviour B18; C5-BOUNDARY/B11 no longer asserts against role-enforcement. Marker-provenance count corrected EIGHT -> NINE (nine tasks were already enumerated) and 003 retagged B11 -> B18. Range statements updated to B1-B18.

Owner-reconciliation review cycle 1 (HEAD 64b5817b, P1x1 + P2x1). P1: the RANGE-COMPLETENESS criterion contained TWO range statements on one 3027-character line; the prior pass's edit corrected the leading "declares the authoritative behaviour range as B1-B17" but left "the union of the two constants MUST equal B1-B17 exactly" intact further along the same line, so the allocation-union assertion still declared the pre-B18 range. Corrected to B1-B18. Re-swept by OCCURRENCE COUNT across all nine coupled artifacts rather than by line match, which is what let the second instance hide: 134.012-T now has zero stale occurrences; the three remaining in 134.011-T and six in the memory file are all inside historical MATRIX CORRECTION / prior-cycle narratives (including CORRECTION 9's deliberate "B1-B17 -> B1-B18" delta) and are correctly preserved. P2: B14 claimed to assert EVERY owner-defined obligation while omitting 134.008-T L45 (reconciled identifiers carried into the deliberation artifact, and the reconciliation INCLUDING the 'no late identifier found' outcome recorded for auditability) and L46 (H5 citation style). Both added as obligations (7) and (8); (7) is flagged as a compound clause requiring both halves, because the no-result half governs the majority of real terminations under the NON-BLOCKING rule and is the half most likely to be dropped. All eight owner criteria L39-L46 now map 1:1 to a B14 obligation with none unmapped. Self-audit after changes: 18 IDs defined, no gaps, no duplicates, allocation disjoint, union exactly B1-B18, all 15 owned behaviours asserted, none foreign.

Owner-reconciliation review cycle 2 (HEAD 53b080fa, P1x2). P1.1: B14 re-resolved against the ENTIRE 134.008-T owner contract atomically rather than patching the count. Review cycle 1 mapped one obligation per owner criterion LINE and asserted zero unmapped, which passes while a compound clause hides inside a line -- and owner criterion L42 carries FIVE obligations, of which only the first two and half the fourth were asserted. Added: (4c) Stage DETECTS more than one entry describing the same expansion; (4d) reconciles into the EARLIEST-CAPTURED entry and REMOVES the duplicates under its own authority; (4e) RECORDS THE MERGE in the deliberation. The remediation half was missing entirely, which matters because a rule that only forbids creating duplicates has nothing to say once duplicates exist -- and a prior-run capture whose entry is not found on re-query is exactly how a second entry appears. Atomic re-resolution also surfaced an unflagged third omission: L40's negative half, that Stage MUST NOT ask Ship to supply identifiers by editing the entry, without which obligation (2) silently reauthorizes a second Ship write. Obligation (7) audit output now covers all THREE outcomes (successful reconciliation, no-late-identifier no-op, duplicate merge). P1.2: B18 test re-roled to [R] REFERENCE-ONLY with an explicit rule that markers must be citation/recognition behaviour and never restated clause prose. Coverage audit: 22 atomic obligations across owner L39-L46, ZERO unmapped; completeness rule is now atomic by construction (a sentence carrying two obligations counts as two).

PR #372 Copilot review-fix cycle 1 — thread PRRT_kwDORzpWpM6amwKd (comment 3816509024), line 85. The task was knowingly oversized with a split line declared but deferred to implementation; the split is taken NOW, into sibling 134.013-T. The cut follows the pre-declared line exactly, extended only by LINEAGE for the three behaviours registered after that line was written: derived behaviours must sit with their parents (B16 = B7 intersect B8 and B17 = B6 union {007-fix-ci}, so all five stay here), and split behaviours stay with their siblings (B18 came out of B11, so both go to 013). This task keeps B3/B4/B5/B6/B7/B8/B9/B16/B17 plus the allocation/structural guards; 013 takes B1/B10/B11/B12/B14/B18. RANGE-COMPLETENESS, union and disjointness are now three-way and IMPORT each sibling module's OWNED_BEHAVIOURS instead of hardcoding a copy — hardcoding would recreate exactly the duplicated-source-of-truth defect at the allocation layer. The import direction is one-way (011/013 -> 012), which keeps the check acyclic and is why the dependency edges are 011 -> 013 -> 012; the prior 013 -> 012 edge was reversed accordingly. Size re-estimated L -> M and 013 sized M; both are independently verifiable and inside the 2-hour rule.

PR #372 review-fix cycle 2 — owner-provenance inventory corrected. The marker-provenance criterion listed 134.002-T as an authoring task for a provisional-priority carve-out reference, but 002's only behaviours (B11 Role Boundary verb list, B12 provisional-priority carve-out) BOTH moved to 134.013-T in cycle 1, so 002 is no longer an owner of this file. The inventory is now DERIVED from this file's OWNED_BEHAVIOURS rather than edited: the union of authoring tasks across {B3,B4,B5,B6,B7,B8,B9,B16,B17} is SIX tasks -- 001, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008 -- each annotated with the specific behaviours it authors. Two narrowings that a hand-edit reliably gets wrong are now explicit: 005 owns only B3 and the B9 [G] guard (H7 excludes it from B4; it performs no thread operation so it is excluded from B7). Root cause recorded as MATRIX CORRECTION 12 in 134.011-T: the CARRIER-SET RESOLUTION rule already forbids hardcoding a carrier list, and this inventory WAS one -- it described carriers by authoring task rather than by surface, so it did not look like the prohibited thing. Precedence rule now stated once in 011: where an inventory and the mapping disagree, the mapping wins and the inventory is the defect.

PR #372 review-fix cycle 3. B17 semantic test extended to assert the complete four-case discovery truth table, that NO branch suppresses capture, and that discovery-status tokens add no seventh payload field. Negative guard added: the test must FAIL against the historical wording "creates NO entry, because the finding is provably already captured". Owner-inventory prose corrected for P2-1 -- 002's only mapped behaviour is B11; its appearance in this task's inventory was never map-supported rather than stale.

Fresh Stage correction operation (post-budget-exhaustion, 2026-08-19). Added ASYMMETRIC-QUALIFIER guard (B5): a THIRD defect shape distinct from the fused-ref and paired-N/A guards, which the terminal P1 evaded by using two separate tokens with no paired-N/A instruction while attaching a single trailing qualifier to the thread ID alone. The guard tests SYMMETRY, not presence -- both refs qualified or neither, never one -- distinguishes a qualifier absent from both (correct on B5-excluded 006 and 007-pr-lifecycle) from one present on a single ref (wrong everywhere), and declares that a literal grep for '(when applicable)' is vacuous. Added LIVE-CARRIER AGREEMENT test (B5): resolves the required form FROM 134.001-T at assertion time rather than hardcoding a copy, closing the absence gap that let a mapped carrier never author its behaviour; dated historical defect records are explicitly excluded from both guards. Scoped B17's truth-table assertion by CARRIER ROLE so reference-only 134.007-T asserts reference integrity rather than restating 134.004-T -- demanding restatement there would contradict H5 and re-create the duplicated-then-stale summary the owner-reconciliation cycle removed from that exact surface.

Fresh Stage operation, review-fix cycle 1 of 3 (HEAD 071d3406). P1-1 fixed here: the SINGLE-WRITE criterion for behaviour B6 had been silently merged into the tail of the new LIVE-CARRIER AGREEMENT (B5) criterion by a tail-splice, leaving B6 with no independently identified criterion despite the B1-B18 allocation mapping it to this file. Restored as its own criterion covering BOTH mapped carriers 004 and 008, with the Ship half (writes once, cannot backfill), the Stage-consumer half (consumes residual-risk records to reconcile late identifiers under Stage authority without weakening Ship's invariant), the negative guard against the historical "only afterward record the PR and review-thread IDs" wording, and the mutual-weakening guard -- all verified present. Also relabelled the B17 criterion to "FIX-CI-ENTRY-REUSE test (behaviour B17)" so the standing per-behaviour audit is mechanically reliable rather than dependent on prose phrasing. Verified: all 18 behaviours now have their own `- [ ]` criterion line; zero criterion lines carry two behaviour markers; zero `., ` splice signatures; three-way allocation disjoint and complete over B1-B18. B5 scoping in this file confirmed correct -- the ASYMMETRIC-QUALIFIER guard already distinguishes absent-from-both (correct on 006/pr-lifecycle) from present-on-one-only (wrong everywhere), and the LIVE-CARRIER AGREEMENT test is scoped to the B5 subset.

Fresh Stage operation, review-fix cycle 2 of 3 (HEAD be2ed019). Two changes here, both consumer-side alignment for the P1 and P2-3. (1) The dependency note credited only 134.013-T for the `OWNED_BEHAVIOURS` import; it now records that this file's RANGE-COMPLETENESS guard imports from BOTH producers (134.013-T boundary group and 134.011-T policy-contract group), making the 011 edge load-bearing twice over -- authoritative map AND producer-side constant -- and noting that authoring order 011 -> 013 -> 012 is exactly the order the constants must exist in for the consumer guard to resolve. No allocation content was restated; the guard still imports rather than hardcodes. (2) P2-3: the canonical `behaviour B16` marker sat on the CONDITIONAL-C3 criterion, which asserts only carrier 001[A], so the structural per-behaviour audit resolved B16 to the NARROW criterion while the load-bearing full-subset dual-path test carried no marker. Moved the canonical marker to the FIX-CI-DUAL-PATH criterion (full B16 subset derived as `B7 INTERSECT B8`) and demoted CONDITIONAL-C3's parenthetical to a non-canonical B16 AUTHORITATIVE-OWNER component reference that explicitly points at the canonical criterion. Verified exactly ONE canonical `behaviour B16` marker exists -- no duplicate marker, no merged criteria, both criteria intact and independently checkable.
